text.description: Message text. Chat safely renders **bold**, *italic*, <u>underline</u>, ~~strike~~, numbered and bulleted lines, > quotes, and fenced code blocks. Use content for other rich content.

content.description: Optional rich message content. Sanitize HTML before passing it to Django; supply exportText for copied transcripts.

attachments.description: Files and images included with the message.

imageUrl.description: Optional image preview URL rendered through Image.

alt.description: Description of the preview image. Defaults to the file name.

reactions.description: Current reactions, rendered as toggle buttons in supplied order. Keep an entry in place while its count remains positive.

label.description: Accessible reaction name and event value.

selected.description: Whether the current user selected this reaction.
